product_wide_rationale: The operator's goals, their measures, and the conflict rules apply to every Domain, and they rank first in Concord's direction.
summary: The operator's goals for Concord: purpose, six equal goals with measures, the conflict rules (Appendix A), constraints, and the conflicts found with current Concord text (Appendix C). Accepted law, ranked first; priorities.md follows it. Where it conflicts with an accepted decision record, goals.md sets the direction, and the conflicting record is amended under CD-0036 D2 (in place when compatible, by a superseding record when breaking) before work relies on it.
title: Concord goals
